test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'W + V' means 'W is the sister of V',

'W # V' means 'W is the husband of V',

'W $ V' means 'W is the daughter of V',

'W % V' means 'W is the mother of V',

'W @ V' means 'W is the brother of V'.

Based on the above, which of the following expressions denotes that 'Y is the wife of Z'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
W is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
$

 
 %
 @
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 Mother
 Brother
 
 

 
 
to V

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Z @ R + K + P % Y → Z is the brother of R who is the sister of K who is sister of P who is the mother of Y.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fed43ffbc566954d0bd70f52e37d1ec2c349ef905cc6ef2d854f084bb9626d43.png] 

Here, Y is either nephew or niece of Z.

 
• Option - (2) : P $ Y % R + K % Z → P is the daughter of Y who is the mother of R who is the sister of K who is the mother of Z.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c38246a2d36443cd744816cf51f31eb785ece140dee64762ba30aa80045db5d2.png] 

Here, Y is the grandmother of Z.

 
• Option - (3) : Y % P # K + R % Z → Y is the mother of P who is the husband of K who is the sister of R who is the mother of Z.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf4a07e83e36670a449e948cd2c54bfcaf32a76e89dbad78f71e7881009c37b8.png] 

Here, Y is the mother-in-law of Z's maternal aunt.

 
• Option - (4) : Y % P + K @ R $ Z → Y is the mother of P who is the sister of K who is the brother R who is the daughter of Z.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122f7e961cc5f0e6c75a4c8e0dbca8de87a8f21f7134b498e846aad34a9a9f39.png] 

Here, **Y is the wife of Z**.

Thus, only option - (4), 'Y % P + K @ R $ Z' shows that Y is the wife of Z.

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
